title: Auralis plug-in identity record
description: The record that is stamped into an adapter binary at build time to declare which Auralis module that binary implements. The same document is written next to the binary as a human readable twin.

module_code.description: Canonical module code from the registry, e.g. AUR_DECLICK.

display_name.description: Human readable module name, e.g. De-Click.

product_name.description: Product line name shown by the host, e.g. Auralis De-Click.

file_description.description: Long description shown in the plug-in browser.

original_filename.description: File name the plug-in is installed under.

internal_name.description: Stable internal identifier used by host session and preset machinery.

vst3_fuid.description: The VST3 class id as a canonical dashed GUID string (32 hexadecimal digits). The string is the identifier and is the same on every platform; the sixteen bytes a binary reports are that string's platform encoding (COM compatible on Windows, big endian elsewhere), so a binary must report the bytes of its own platform for the host to read this string back.

aax_effect_ids.description: One (manufacturer id, product id, plug id) triple per channel variant: mono, mono-to-stereo and stereo. Each component is exactly four characters.

param_id_map.description: Host parameter id -> canonical core parameter name. The ids come from the generated registry index.
